{/* Executive KPI Summary Cards */}

{classes.length} lớp

Đang mở trong học kỳ

{classes.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.studentCount ?? 30), 0)} SV

Ghi danh chính thức

{t('lecturer.classes.stat_subjects', 'Môn học')}
{new Set(classes.map(c => c.subject?.code || c.subjectId)).size || classes.length} học phần

Chương trình chuyên ngành

{t('lecturer.classes.stat_semester', 'Học kỳ')}
Spring 2026

Học kỳ hiện tại

{t('lecturer.classes.list_title', 'Danh sách lớp học phụ trách')} ({classes.length})

{loading ? (
{t('ui.loading_classes', 'Đang tải danh sách lớp học...')}
) : classes.length === 0 ? (

{t('lecturer.classes.empty', 'Chưa có lớp học nào được phân công.')}

 ) : (
{classes.map((c: any) => (
{c.classCode} {c.studentCount ?? 30} {t('lecturer.classes.students', 'SV')}

{c.subject?.name || c.subject?.code}

{t('lecturer.classes.subject_code', 'Mã môn')}: {c.subject?.code}

{t('lecturer.classes.semester', 'Kỳ: Spring 2026')}
))}
)}
) }

// Backend request/response contracts. UI view models belong in their feature.

export interface AuthUser {
  id: string
  email: string
  fullName: string
  name: string
  role: 'admin' | 'lecturer' | 'student'
  status: string
  campus?: string
  externalId?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  phone?: string
  lecturerCode?: string
  studentCode?: string
  // true khi tài khoản được tạo qua import — hệ thống ép đổi mật khẩu lần đầu đăng nhập
  requirePasswordChange?: boolean
}

export interface UserRow {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
  status: string
  studentCode?: string
  lecturerCode?: string
  phone?: string
  avatar?: string
  lastLoginAt?: string
  enrolledClasses?: any[]
  instructingClasses?: any[]
}

export interface BulkDeleteUsersResult {
  deleted: string[]
  /** Ids that were already gone — not an error, a repeated attempt is harmless. */
  skipped: string[]
  failed: Array<{ id: string; reason: string }>
  success: boolean
  message: string
}

export interface ImportUserRow {
  fullName: string
  email: string
  classCode?: string
  semesterCode?: string
  subjectCode?: string
  role: 'ADMIN' | 'LECTURER' | 'STUDENT'
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'LOCKED'
}

export interface CreateUserBody {
  email: string
  password: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  studentCode?: string
  lecturerCode?: string
  phone?: string
  campus?: string
  avatar?: string | null
  classIds?: string[]
  externalId?: string
}

export interface ClassRow {
  id: string
  code: string
  name: string
  subject: string | { id: string; code: string; name: string }
  subjectCode?: string
  subjectName?: string
  semester: string | { id: string; code: string }
  campus?: string
  schedule?: string
  lecturer?: AuthUser
  lecturers?: AuthUser[]
  studentCount?: number
  count?: number
  // Internal staff note â€” present only for ADMIN/LECTURER (BE omits it for students).
  note?: string | null
}

export interface CreateClassBody {
  code: string
  name?: string
  subjectId: string
  semesterId?: string
  campus?: string
  schedule?: string
  lecturerId?: string
  keepExistingInstructors?: boolean
  studentIds?: string[]
}

export interface ImportUsersResult {
  totalProcessed: number
  successCount: number
  errorCount: number
  errors: string[]
}

export interface StudentRow {
  id?: string
  studentId: string
  name: string
  email: string
  avatar?: string
  progress: string
  grade: string
}

export interface AssignmentRow {
  runtimeLanguage?: string | null
  testCases?: { id: string; input: string; expectedOutput: string; points: number; isHidden: boolean }[]
  documentContent?: string
  documentAnalysis?: {
    language?: string | null
    platform?: string | null

import { request } from '../client'
import type { SubjectRow, SemesterRow, CreateSemesterBody, CreateSeasonBody } from '../contracts'

export const semestersApi = {
  getSemesters: (options: Pick<RequestInit, 'cache'> = {}) => request<SemesterRow[]>(`/semesters`, options),

  createSemester: (body: CreateSemesterBody) =>
    request<SemesterRow>('/semesters', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),

  createSeason: (body: CreateSeasonBody) =>
    request<SemesterRow[]>('/semesters/season', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),

  updateSemester: (id: string, body: Partial<CreateSemesterBody>) =>
    request<SemesterRow>(`/semesters/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),

  deleteSemester: (id: string) =>
    request<void>(`/semesters/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  getSemesterSubjects: (semesterId: string) => request<SubjectRow[]>(`/semesters/${semesterId}/subjects`),

  addSemesterSubjects: (semesterId: string, subjectIds: string[]) => request<void>(`/semesters/${semesterId}/subjects`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ subjectIds }) }),

  removeSemesterSubject: (semesterId: string, subjectId: string) => request<void>(`/semesters/${semesterId}/subjects/${subjectId}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  deleteSeason: (season: string) => request<void>(`/semesters/season/${encodeURIComponent(season)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  activateSeason: (season: string) => request<{ season: string; isActive: boolean }>(`/semesters/season/${encodeURIComponent(season)}/activate`, { method: 'POST' }),

  getClassesBySubject: (semesterId: string, subjectId: string) => request<any[]>(`/semesters/${semesterId}/subjects/${subjectId}/classes`),
}

import { request } from '../client'
import type { UserRow, BulkDeleteUsersResult, ImportUserRow, CreateUserBody, ImportUsersResult } from '../contracts'

export const usersApi = {
  getUsers: (role = 'all', page = 1, limit = 10, search?: string) =>
    request<UserRow[]>(`/users?role=${role}&page=${page}&limit=${limit}${search ? `&search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}` : ''}`),

  getUser: (id: string) => request<any>(`/users/${id}`),

  createUser: (body: CreateUserBody | FormData) =>
    request<UserRow>('/users', { method: 'POST', body: body instanceof FormData ? body : JSON.stringify(body) }),

  updateUser: (id: string, body: (Partial<CreateUserBody> & { status?: string, updatedClasses?: { classId: string, newClassCode: string, newSubjectCode?: string, semesterCode?: string, isNew?: boolean }[], deletedClasses?: string[], addedClasses?: string[] }) | FormData) =>
    request<UserRow>(`/users/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: body instanceof FormData ? body : JSON.stringify(body) }),

  deleteUser: (id: string) =>
    request<void>(`/users/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  bulkDeleteUsers: (ids: string[]) =>
    request<BulkDeleteUsersResult>(`/users/bulk-delete`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ ids }) }),

  toggleUserLock: (id: string, locked: boolean) =>
    request<UserRow>(`/users/${id}/lock`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ locked }) }),

  importUsers: (body: { users: ImportUserRow[] } | FormData) =>
    request<ImportUsersResult>(`/users/import`, { method: 'POST', body: body instanceof FormData ? body : JSON.stringify(body) }),

  importStudentsExcel: (body: FormData) =>
    request<any>(`/users/import-students-excel`, { method: 'POST', body }),

  importLecturersExcel: (body: FormData) =>
    request<any>(`/users/import-lecturers-excel`, { method: 'POST', body }),

  importTeachingAssignmentsExcel: (body: FormData) =>
    request<any>(`/users/import-teaching-assignments-excel`, { method: 'POST', body }),
}

import type { SubmissionRow } from '../contracts'

function toNullableNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null
  const parsed = Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null
}

export function normalizeSubmissionRow(raw: any): SubmissionRow {
  const studentObj = raw?.student && typeof raw.student === 'object' ? raw.student : null
  const examObj = raw?.exam && typeof raw.exam === 'object' ? raw.exam : null
  const classObj = raw?.class && typeof raw.class === 'object' ? raw.class : null
  const fileObj = raw?.file && typeof raw.file === 'object' ? raw.file : null

  let parsedReport: any = null
  try {
    if (raw?.reportData) {
      parsedReport = typeof raw.reportData === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw.reportData) : raw.reportData
    }
  } catch (e) { }

  const failedReport = !!parsedReport?.error
  const fallbackScore = !failedReport && parsedReport?.totalScore != null ? toNullableNumber(parsedReport.totalScore) : null
  const normalizedAiScore = failedReport ? null : toNullableNumber(raw?.aiScore ?? raw?.rawScore) ?? fallbackScore
  const normalizedScore = failedReport ? null : toNullableNumber(raw?.score ?? raw?.finalScore ?? raw?.rawScore) ?? fallbackScore
  const studentName = typeof raw?.student === 'string'
    ? raw.student
    : (studentObj?.fullName || studentObj?.name || raw?.studentName || studentObj?.studentCode || raw?.studentId || 'Sinh viên')

  const studentCode = typeof raw?.studentCode === 'string'
    ? raw.studentCode
    : (studentObj?.studentCode || studentObj?.code || raw?.studentCode || raw?.studentId || studentObj?.id || '')

  const assignmentTitle = typeof raw?.assignment === 'string'
    ? raw.assignment
    : (examObj?.title || raw?.assignment?.title || raw?.assignmentTitle || null)


  let filename = raw?.filename ?? fileObj?.filename ?? fileObj?.fileName ?? undefined
  if (!filename && (raw?.zipFileUrl || raw?.downloadUrl || raw?.ZipFileUrl)) {
    const targetUrl = String(raw?.zipFileUrl || raw?.downloadUrl || raw?.ZipFileUrl || '')
    try {
      const match = targetUrl.match(/filename=([^&]+)/i)
      if (match && match[1]) {
        filename = decodeURIComponent(match[1])
      } else {
        const cleanUrl = targetUrl.split('?')[0]
        const segments = cleanUrl.split('/')
        const last = segments[segments.length - 1]
        if (last && (last.includes('.') || last.toLowerCase().includes('zip'))) {
          filename = decodeURIComponent(last)
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return {
    id: String(raw?.id ?? raw?.Id ?? ''),
    assignmentId: raw?.assignmentId ?? raw?.examId ?? raw?.ExamId ?? raw?.exam?.id ?? '',
    examId: raw?.examId ?? raw?.ExamId ?? raw?.assignmentId ?? raw?.exam?.id ?? null,
    assignment: assignmentTitle,
    classId: raw?.classId ?? raw?.ClassId ?? classObj?.id ?? null,
    studentId: String(studentCode),
    studentUserId: raw?.studentUserId ?? studentObj?.id ?? raw?.studentId ?? raw?.StudentId ?? null,
    student: String(studentName),
    status: raw?.status ?? raw?.gradingStatus ?? raw?.GradingStatus ?? 'pending',
    gradingStatus: raw?.gradingStatus ?? raw?.GradingStatus ?? raw?.status ?? null,
    gradingError: raw?.gradingError ?? null,
    reviewStatus: raw?.reviewStatus ?? raw?.ReviewStatus ?? null,
    isPublished: raw?.isPublished === true || String(raw?.reviewStatus ?? raw?.ReviewStatus).toUpperCase() === 'PUBLISHED',
    attemptNumber: raw?.attemptNumber ?? raw?.AttemptNumber ?? 1,
    submittedAt: raw?.submittedAt ?? raw?.SubmittedAt ?? null,
    gradedAt: raw?.gradedAt ?? raw?.GradedAt ?? null,
    reviewedAt: raw?.reviewedAt ?? raw?.ReviewedAt ?? null,
    content: raw?.content ?? raw?.Content ?? null,
    language: raw?.language ?? raw?.Language ?? null,
    zipFileUrl: raw?.zipFileUrl ?? raw?.ZipFileUrl ?? undefined,
    downloadUrl: raw?.downloadUrl ?? fileObj?.downloadUrl ?? raw?.zipFileUrl ?? raw?.ZipFileUrl ?? undefined,
    filename: filename,
    score: normalizedScore,
    maxScore: toNullableNumber(raw?.maxScore ?? parsedReport?.maxPossibleScore ?? examObj?.totalPoints),
    aiScore: normalizedAiScore,
    totalScore: failedReport ? null : toNullableNumber(raw?.totalScore) ?? fallbackScore,
    finalScore: failedReport ? null : toNullableNumber(raw?.finalScore) ?? fallbackScore,
    rawScore: failedReport ? null : raw?.rawScore ?? raw?.score ?? raw?.finalScore ?? fallbackScore,
    rawAiScore: failedReport ? null : raw?.aiScore ?? raw?.rawScore ?? fallbackScore,
    reportData: parsedReport,
    latePenaltyAmount: toNullableNumber(raw?.latePenaltyAmount),
    isReopened: raw?.isReopened ?? false,
    reopenReason: raw?.reopenReason ?? null,
    extendedDueDate: raw?.extendedDueDate ?? raw?.ExtendedDueDate ?? null,
    ruleScores: raw?.ruleScores ?? raw?.RuleScores ?? parsedReport?.ruleScores ?? null,
    aiFeedback: raw?.aiFeedback ?? parsedReport?.overallFeedback ?? null,
    instructorFeedback: raw?.instructorFeedback ?? null,
    studentFeedback: raw?.studentFeedback ?? null,
  }
}
